title: The Relationship of Tree Nuts and Peanuts with Adiposity Parameters: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.

answer.design_quote: Once the consistency was evaluated, we conducted standard random-effects meta-analyses to determine the standardized mean differences (SMDs) of the interventions on the four adiposity outcomes using the Dersimonian and Laird method [ 34 ].
answer.k_quote: A total of 105 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with measures of BW (n = 6768 participants), BMI (n = 2918), WC (n = 5045), and BF% (n = 1226) were included.
